title: Comfort, rear-seat room, and tech setup impressions
summary: This topic combines praise for comfort, rear-seat room, and styling with a few comments about digital setup and login-related hassles, while many examples remain too fragmentary or inconsistently labeled to interpret cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G70's comfortable seating, usable rear-seat room, and attractive exterior.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on a frustrating eSIM setup process.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention dealer visits, futuristic displays, strong cabin sound, styling, profile or app login issues, and nonworking ambient lights without enough context to confirm the intended sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic clusters several loosely related subjects, including comfort, styling, display impressions, account login issues, dealer visits, and lighting faults, so it is not a tightly coherent single theme.
Many examples are labeled undetermined despite language that could imply either praise or complaints, which limits sentiment interpretation.
Examples are limited to short fragments, so broader customer intent and severity cannot be verified from the supplied text alone.
